name: Hanna: Futile Resistance
source:
Hanna: Futile Resistance is an interactive adult visual novel that takes you along for a ride following the adventures or more to the point, the misadventures of Hanna McGuinness as she navigates her way through a sexy, fun filled journey layered with erotic tension and filthy pervyness, ever increasing to new highs... and lows.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/x3rr4]Patreon[/url]]
